artifact: Issue #9 M4-3 operation registration and dispatch contract

registration_owner.rule: Register LIFECYCLE_DESCRIPTORS in the canonical HandlerRegistry exactly once; preserve the five existing read descriptors and avoid the legacy read-only OperationContract conversion for lifecycle descriptors.

handler_owner.rule: Add only thin lifecycle handler bindings and keep all existing read-only handlers unchanged.
handler_owner.handler_binding: lazy, deterministic, and idempotent through ensure_handlers_bound

write_entry_point.relationship_to_read_path: The existing execute function remains read-only and unchanged in routing semantics; execute_mutation is the write-capable variant of the same canonical ingress boundary.
lookup_order: reject read-only descriptor on the write entry point
validate typed envelope and operation-specific payload
verify trusted principal and exact lease bindings

adapter_rule: CLI, Hermes, and future adapters may construct an internal typed request but must call execute_mutation; none may call plan_init or retire_plan directly.
generic_mutation_api: forbidden; the dispatch set is an explicit closed set of accepted lifecycle operations
